read.thesis: Q3 call is deposit-cost defensive: HK time-deposit mix drifting up toward 40% and UK LCR falling, while management says deposits stay accretive and buybacks depend on loan growth; no numeric guidance change.

triggers.label: HK time-deposit mix ~38% → ~40%
triggers.quote: The time deposit ratio was at around 38% at the end of September. In October, it's nudged a little more

triggers.label: Deposit margin pressure in HK
triggers.quote: The key thing is not just that shift, it's deposit margin pressure, but overall we stay in the positive space

triggers.label: UK LCR being run down
triggers.quote: I don't think 150% is a sensible number. People have talked in terms of peers , who want to be in the 120s or 130s.

triggers.label: Q4 cost of risk guidance unchanged
triggers.quote: In terms of Q4, we are not changing our guidance as of now

guidance.quote: Over the years we have tracked through the cycle between 30 basis points to 40 basis points.

red_flags.label: HK deposit margin pressure from time-deposit migration
red_flags.quote: The key thing is not just that shift, it's deposit margin pressure

red_flags.label: Loan growth consuming capital; buybacks residual
red_flags.quote: lending growth, which consumes RWAs, and can take away a good chunk of the organic capital generation

evasions.quote: there's no specific number which says, 40% is a good , or 41%, or 39%, or whatever.
I'm not giving any guidance for 2027, just the building blocks.
